description: This Java class defines a Fragment called LogFragment that displays a log view within a scrollable interface, used for outputting log data received via the LogNode interface. It manages UI components such as LogView and ScrollView, and handles text change events to keep the view scrolled to the bottom.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that contains a LogView and ScrollView to display log messages, with methods to initialize views and handle text changes.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, padding, and adding the LogView to the ScrollView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher on LogView to auto-scroll on text change, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within the fragment.
